geometry.note: fine kod units, 64 per square; null means no floor found in that column/row of the region

why: spidertrap1 — a journey Castle Victoria -> the Royal Blacksmith of Barloque crossing the Cragged Mountains (578) south-to-north. The character arrived at 16:30:45Z from 579 and never left under its own power: every ~70s it boarded the baked line from the west anchor toward the north door and slipped at the same index, then aimed an undeclared fall two rows north with a black spider on the line and did not take it. Vigor fell 4/min the whole time. The journey timed out at 900s, the keeper revived, the journey was issued again five seconds later, and the loop resumed. Pulled out by the operator at ~16:47Z.
coordinate_note: unit positions are col,row (x,y fine). The tactics ledger notes quoted under `trap` are ROW,COL — m59-game.mjs writes `${row},${col}` there. 45,16 in a note is the subject's square, col 16 row 45.
geometry_note: an outdoor room: floor exists in every column, so `geometry` says 0..3134 everywhere and tells you nothing. The trap is a HEIGHT edge — the aims are undeclared FALLS with a linegap of 18..284 — and floor extents do not carry height. A test must read the BSP heights along the fall line (row 45..46 -> row 43..44, cols 13..16) at fine resolution; see docs/m59-routing.md on 40,33.
